{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
num_duplicates = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
missing_baseline = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Output the counts
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {num_duplicates}')
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline}')"}
